bio: An intriguing, innovative concept combining Tagesbar (daytime bar, serving great cocktails) and Esszimmer (meaning dining room). Hidden behind a curtain, and with only a handful of covers, the stylish restaurant has a pleasantly private feel. They serve a modern set menu (a vegetarian version is available if pre-ordered), in which chef Alexander Kumptner incorporates the occasional and subtle Italian or Asian accent into his own style – vongole, 'nduja, orzo, basil is a good example. The focus is on the high quality of the ingredients. The professional and charming service runs like clockwork....
